content.name: Claire Donnelly
content.title: Store Manager
content.summary: Store manager with 20 years in UK retail, from department stores and fashion to food halls. Runs a £19m food and drink store with 140 colleagues, and turned it from the region's worst-performing site on availability and waste into its best within two years.

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Lead a £19m food hall and café with 140 colleagues and six department managers, accountable for sales, payroll, margin and compliance.
Raised on-shelf availability from 91% to 97.5% by redesigning overnight replenishment and ordering with the supply team.
Halved food waste as a share of sales through reduced-to-clear timings and a surplus food partnership with two local charities.
Hold the premises licence responsibilities as designated premises supervisor and maintained a clean record across three local authority inspections.
Ran the store through the 2020–21 lockdowns, setting up queue management and a click-and-collect service within ten days.

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Managed a £9m convenience-format supermarket with 65 colleagues.
Grew like-for-like sales by an average of 4.6% a year for five years against a flat regional market.
Cut colleague turnover from 52% to 31% by introducing fixed-hour contracts and a buddy system for new starters.
Achieved a five-rated food hygiene score at every inspection.

experience.title: Deputy Store Manager
bullets: Deputised for the store manager of a three-floor fashion store with £6.5m turnover and 48 staff.
Led the move to a new stock management system, completing the switchover with two days of downtime instead of the planned five.
Planned rotas and annual leave for the whole store, keeping payroll within 0.5% of budget.

experience.title: Department Manager
bullets: Ran the homewares and lighting departments, worth £2.2m a year, with a team of 12.
Negotiated concession space with three suppliers, adding £180,000 of rental income.
Trained as a fire marshal and first aider for the shop floor.

achievements.title: Regional turnaround
achievements.detail: Store moved from last to first in the region on availability and waste within two years.

achievements.detail: Seven colleagues promoted to department manager or above since 2020.
